bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating exact match accuracy on the WinoBias coreference resolution dataset, which is reformatted as a question-answering task to compare performance on pro-bias (stereotypical) versus anti-bias subsets.
Using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset to measure the frequency of stereotype-supporting (pro-bias) answers on multiple-choice questions with both ambiguous and unambiguous contexts.
